shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && ls -la && echo "-----" && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100

cat package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html src/App.tsx src/main.tsx && echo "-----ROUTING TOP-----" && head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "-----TRAPS theming-----" && grep -n -i -C 6 'ThemeProvider\|theme' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -120 && echo "-----INSPECT-----" && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme Switch Button Icon 2>&1 | head -60

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme Switch SegmentedRadioGroup RadioButton 2>&1 | head -80; echo "-----VERSION-----"; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>&1 | head; echo "-----EVAL-----"; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo "-----THEME DTS-----"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts 2>&1

echo "-----SWITCH DTS-----" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && echo "-----CONTROL PROPS-----" && grep -n -A 25 'export interface ControlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && echo "-----README setup-----" && grep -n -i -A 30 'required setup\|## usage' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -60 && echo "-----ONLINE-----" && curl -sS -m 20 -o /tmp/uikit7.md -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt && head -c 300 /tmp/uikit7.md && echo && grep -n -i -m 20 'switch\|ThemeProvider\|localStorage' /tmp/uikit7.md | head -40
ls node_modules | grep -i -E '^(jsdom|happy-dom|@testing-library)$'; echo "---"; cat .gitignore; echo "---"; git status --short
